Our Philosophy

Your Luxury Beauty
Studio in KL

At Lumié Studio KL in Desa Sri Hartamas, beauty is more than a service — it's a ritual. Our team of skilled stylists and technicians specialise in hair colour & balayage, gel & BIAB nails, waxing & threading, and restorative facials. Whether you're walking in for the first time or returning for your monthly touch-up, every visit is crafted to leave you feeling luminous, confident, and elevated.
